title: ranunculus flabellatus subsp. chaerophylloides
intro: Ranunculus flabellatus subsp. chaerophylloides, commonly known as Yellow Bulbous Buttercup, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus flabellatus subsp. chaerophylloides include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic, making it useful for wound healing and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, but further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
